one_line: OpenAI pushes policy, AI firms see acquisitions, investments, and open‑source tool releases.

themes.title: OpenAI launches post‑midterm policy push
themes.text: OpenAI will begin a policy and public‑relations campaign after the U.S. midterm elections, advocating mandatory safety safeguards, speed limits on advanced AI, and rebranding its data centers as AI compute campuses.

stories.headline: OpenAI to launch post‑midterm policy push, propose AI speed limits and rename data centers

themes.title: AI startups acquired by industry leaders
themes.text: Guidewire announced a $1.7 billion cash acquisition of Hyperexponential, Deepgram bought Daily while keeping its Pipecat framework open source, and ServiceNow acquired Israeli startup Sweep to accelerate CRM migrations.

stories.headline: Guidewire to acquire Hyperexponential for $1.7 billion in cash
Deepgram acquires Daily, keeping open‑source Pipecat framework intact
ServiceNow acquires Israeli startup Sweep to speed CRM migrations

themes.title: Major capital inflows into AI firms
themes.text: Saudi Aramco purchased a 49% stake in AI startup Humain for about $2.6 billion in cash, and Chinese BCI startup NeuroXess raised RMB 700 million in Series B funding for trials and manufacturing expansion.

stories.headline: Saudi Aramco buys 49% of AI startup Humain, adds $2.6 billion cash
NeuroXess raises RMB 700 million Series B to expand BCI trials and manufacturing

themes.title: DeepSeek unveils open‑source Super‑Agent
themes.text: DeepSeek released Super‑Agent, an open‑source research prototype that monitors a GitHub repository and developer chats, then proactively suggests fixes or opens pull requests under an MIT license.

stories.headline: DeepSeek releases open‑source Super‑Agent, a proactive coding assistant prototype
